preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(0 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line contains integers n (2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and m (n-1 ≤ m ≤ 10^6), where n is the number of destinations and m is the number of corridors. Each subsequent line contains three integers a, b, and e (1 ≤ a, b ≤ n, a ≠ b, 0 ≤ e ≤ 10^9), representing a corridor between destinations a and b with energy e. The graph is connected.
The input consists of exactly m+1 lines: one for n and m, and m lines for the corridors.
Each corridor line contains exactly three space-separated integers.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing E_max(c_1), where c_1 is the first corridor in the input, and 0 ≤ E_max(c_1) ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: The output E_max(c_1) is the largest e ≤ 10^9 such that if the energy of the first corridor c_1 is set to e, then c_1 is part of at least one minimum spanning tree (MST) of the graph.

postconditions.expression: c1_original_e == int(stdin.splitlines()[1].split()[2]) and c1_original_e > int(stdout.strip()) ==> any(all(e == c1_original_e for a, b, e in mst_edges) for mst_edges in [get_mst_edges(edges_with_e_modified(c1_original_e, e)) for e in range(int(stdout.strip()) + 1, c1_original_e + 1)])
postconditions.description: If the original energy of c_1 is greater than E_max(c_1), then c_1 is not part of any MST when its energy is set to any value greater than E_max(c_1). (Helper definitions: edges_with_e_modified(c1_original_e, e) replaces the first corridor's energy with e; get_mst_edges(edges) returns the edges of an MST for the given edges.)

postconditions.expression: c1_original_e <= int(stdout.strip()) ==> any(all(e == c1_original_e for a, b, e in mst_edges) for mst_edges in [get_mst_edges(edges_with_e_modified(c1_original_e, e)) for e in range(c1_original_e, int(stdout.strip()) + 1)])
postconditions.description: If the original energy of c_1 is less than or equal to E_max(c_1), then c_1 is part of at least one MST when its energy is set to any value up to E_max(c_1). (Helper definitions as in Q3.)
